parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the origin pool is enabled.

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the origin pool. The name must be unique within a site.

parameters.name: Origins
parameters.description: The list of origins to add to the origin pool. Use an array to specify multiple origins.

sub_parameters.name: Address
sub_parameters.description: The address of the origin. For example, www\.example.com.

sub_parameters.name: AuthConf
sub_parameters.description: The authentication configuration for the origin. Required if the origin is an OSS or AWS S3 bucket that requires authentication.

sub_parameters.name: Enabled
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the origin is enabled.

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

sub_parameters.name: Header
sub_parameters.description: The request header to include in back-to-origin requests. Only the `Host` header is supported.

sub_parameters.name: IpVersionPolicy
sub_parameters.description:
The IP protocol version for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:

- `round_robin`: Default. Randomly selects an IPv4 or IPv6 origin.

- `ipv4_first`: Prioritizes IPv4 origins.

- `ipv6_first`: Prioritizes IPv6 origins.

- `follow`: Uses the same IP protocol version as the client's request.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the origin. The name must be unique within the origin pool.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the origin. Valid values:

- `ip_domain`: An IP address or a domain name.

- `OSS`: An Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket.

- `S3`: An AWS S3 bucket.

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description: The weight of the origin. The value must be an integer from 0 to 100.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. To obtain this ID, call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.
